assumptions: Initial sampled edge asserts reset; all subsequent reset, full recovery, requests, live qualifiers and candidate indices are unconstrained top-level inputs.
environment: The independent ordered four-entry ledger gates downstream resource readiness using pre-cycle space; no DUT readiness or output is assumed.
Rename source and destination addresses range over x0 through x3; hardware retains all 32 architectural mappings, 64 physical tags and 8 checkpoint slots. All map, free and ready bits are asserted.

Live writebacks select any ledger instruction, allowing out-of-order completion and duplicate offers. Non-live offers carry arbitrary six-bit tags, including reused ones. Upstream producer/generation validation is modeled, not implemented or proved.

Resolution selects any slot and may be non-live; retirement is an oldest completed prefix of up to two instructions and cannot pass an unresolved CFI. Same-cycle WB can qualify retirement; recovery overrides acceptance.

Expected outputs and ledger transitions derive only from inputs and independent state. Branch age and reclaimed tags derive from instruction positions, without copying DUT checkpoint snapshots or histories.
mutation_policy: Copied DUT sources under out/ disable all DUT assertions for mutations. An explicitly named independent monitor assertion and a counterexample are required; timeout or another failure is not detection.
claim: Unbounded safety by k-induction for the connected rename subsystem under the four-inflight, x0-x3 workload contract. Full hardware geometry is retained. Depth-12 covers and mutation checks are bounded. This is not arbitrary-register/workload ownership, full resource exhaustion, upstream ROB/generation identity validation, ROB wrap, processor integration, liveness or the complete two-wide formal milestone.
state_invariants: Committed mappings are unique and nonzero except x0; untouched x4-x31 retain their reset mapping.
Every live destination is distinct from committed and earlier live owners; stale tags follow the ordered map walk. Unused ledger entries are zero.
Checkpoint slots are uniquely owned by unresolved CFIs. Snapshots, younger-allocation histories and age masks equal independent ledger reconstructions.

The reference allocator searches p1-p3 and p32-p35. Pool closure, fixed free/ready bits, live tag bounds, nonzero ownership and agreement with the full-sized DUT allocator are asserted, not assumed. Four in-flight entries and three writable names cannot exhaust this pool when admission has space.
